messages:
Maya R: quick question for the group: do we want an API that can return the concrete list of targets after routing + throttles? thinking a dry-run endpoint so UI can preview who will actually be notified before saving policy.
Ian L: yes please. saves a lot of surprises. curious if we should include the reason each target was chosen (eg: override, pool, fallback).
Priya N: +1. for console we need a compact "why" field per target. e.g. 'pool_match', 'tenant_override', 'rate_limited_fallback'.
Maya R: proposed endpoint: GET /v1/slo/:id/notify-snapshot?dry_run=true&as_of=ts -> returns declared_policy + resolved_targets[] with reason & current_quota_status. lightweight JSON.
Sam T: do we expose quota counters (remaining/minute) in the snapshot? might be sensitive but useful for preview. could show percentile (low/med/high) instead of exact numbers.
Priya N: agree on obfuscation. show numeric in dev & staging, percentile in prod UI. API flag `detail=full|summary`.
Ian L: how does this interact with sampling? if sampling_rate=0.01, the snapshot should indicate expected notify fraction and any upsampling rules for evals.
Maya R: add `expected_notify_fraction` and `sampling_reason` to snapshot. sampling_reason enums: cost_saving, regression_eval, telemetry_audit.
Sam T: throttling rules: we need two layers: per-pool burst cap and per-tenant steady cap. if pool burst exceeded, route to fallback (email or lower-priority channel). document fallback chain.
Priya N: console UX: in editor show a miniature timeline graph for the last 6h of notify volume for the selected pool + an indicator if the intended policy would trigger fallback currently. helpful for rollouts.
Ian L: implementation note: compute snapshot server-side using the most recent tokenized state in control plane. avoid client merging.
Maya R: security note: snapshot should require `slo.read` + `notify.preview` scopes. otherwise only declared policy is returned.
deploy-bot: rollout planned: notify-snapshot-v1 -> canary on 2 nodes at 2026-02-12T08:00Z
Sam T: QA concern: snapshot must be idempotent for a given as_of timestamp. otherwise UI diffs are pointless.
Priya N: add test case: create tenant override that points to a dead channel -> snapshot should include `target_status: unreachable` and suggested remediation (e.g., 'contact deleted, link to fix').
Ian L: logging/telemetry: emit `notify.snapshot.request` with outcome {previewed|blocked|partial} and sampling_reason. tie into billing so preview-heavy customers are throttled.
Maya R: action items: (1) Ian to draft API spec + auth requirements; (2) Sam to write throttling fallback matrix and default caps; (3) Priya to mock console preview and timeline graph; (4) Maya to add telemetry events list. sync Monday.
